automated_checks.note: No collision was found in the declared geometry contract, but only page 6 has strict element annotations.
The deck has no requestFullscreen or webkitRequestFullscreen implementation and no visible fullscreen control.
Static content remained visually stable in the sampled offline render, while web fonts and animated transitions still depend on external URLs.

strengths: The redesign now reads as one coherent editorial presentation rather than a set of content cards.
The light and dark sequence creates a deliberate chapter rhythm without repeating one layout three times in succession.
The route, completion record, failure chain, delivery map, gates, responsibility boundary, evidence stack, ladder, and flywheel visibly match their declared semantic relations.
Every page has a clear three-second headline, stable margins, page numbering, and a protected bottom navigation area.
The four-part narrative remains faithful to the approved outline and does not restore the superseded six-chapter structure.

findings.finding: Fullscreen is missing even though the artifact is intended for live presentation.
findings.recommended_action: Add a visible fullscreen control and an F-key shortcut with standard and WebKit fullscreen fallbacks.

findings.finding: Several explanatory labels use 0.78vw to 0.92vw type with 0.65 to 0.72 opacity. They are legible on a laptop but fragile at the back of a classroom or on a low-contrast projector.
findings.recommended_action: Raise functional copy to at least max(14px, 0.9vw), increase opacity, and shorten the flywheel and evidence captions before enlarging them.

findings.finding: Only page 6 exposes a strict page-addressable geometry contract, so automated collision evidence does not cover the rest of the deck.
findings.recommended_action: Add stable data-qa roles to structural nodes and real connectors on the remaining semantic diagram pages, prioritizing pages 3, 5, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 17, 20, and 21.

findings.finding: Web fonts and animated transitions are loaded from external URLs.
findings.recommended_action: Keep the current static fallback, and package local fonts and motion code if fully offline delivery is a requirement.
